# The bathroom: a checker-tiled floor 14.4 x 8.8 m and the back wall behind the tub (sage tiles),
# 5 m tall; a bath mat in front of the tub. Only the faces the camera sees. Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Floor --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Wall --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new Mat --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name Floor --size 1 --location 0 -0.6 0
scale 14.4 8.8 1
apply --scale
material assign Floor
active Floor
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Floor base-color textures/floor.png
add mesh plane --name Wall --size 1 --location 0 3.8 2.5
scale 14 5 1
apply --scale
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
material assign Wall
active Wall
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view front --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Wall base-color textures/wall.png
add mesh cube --name Mat --size 1 --location -1.2 -3.7 0.04
scale 3 2 0.08
apply --scale
material assign Mat
active Mat
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
delete only-faces
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Mat base-color textures/mat.png
select all
shade flat
export room.glb
